== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original [[Hypo]] and [[Hypo (PC Errata)]] articles. Columns are Original · PC Errata (Appendix A). Glossary 2.0 clarification is leftover (no (Errata) article; Revised reprints it as Versions). Same-words Holotable [[Hypo (PC Errata 2)]] and [[Hypo (PC Errata 3)]] fold into PC Errata. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Revised, foil, or (V) articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata · PC Errata (omit missing). {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
